settings.name: Spa Pallet Services Ltd
settings.about: A family business founded by John and Caroline McKay in 1997. From its Ballynahinch facility, Spa Pallet Services supports businesses with pallet supply, collection, refurbishment and recycling, alongside haulage across Ireland and the UK.

services.title: Buy pallets
services.short: New and reconditioned pallets for your business.
services.body: Pallet supply for manufacturing, warehousing and distribution. Tell the team the size, grade, quantity and delivery location you need.

services.title: Sell and recycle pallets
services.short: Turn surplus pallets into usable stock.
services.body: Collection and purchase of surplus, redundant and non-returnable pallets. One-off and regular clearances are offered throughout Northern Ireland and Ireland.

services.title: Pallet collars
services.short: New and used collars for secure storage.
services.body: Wooden pallet collars for warehousing, factory handling and transport. Discuss size, condition and quantity with the team.

services.title: Pallet furniture
services.short: Seating and furniture made from timber pallets.
services.body: Pallet furniture available by quotation, including seating, tables and customised sets. Discuss the arrangement and finish you need.

services.title: Haulage
services.short: Commercial transport across Ireland and the UK.
services.body: Haulage services using the company’s own fleet of articulated and rigid vehicles with curtainside trailers. Ask about your load, collection and delivery requirements.
